messages:
Morgan Lee: Quick sync — we need to lock the long-term plan for routing + multi-region isolation. Two enterprise customers (FinCorp, HealthCo) pushed for region pinning and tenant-level isolation.
Ashley (PM): Can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves for MVP? Customers are asking for per-tenant region pinning, predictable egress IPs, and SLA for cross-region failover.
Devin (Eng-Arch): MVP suggestion: tenant-aware routing table + region affinity + fallback policy. No full VPC/air-gap for MVP. Isolation via network namespaces + request tagging.
Sam (Infra): Agree. For isolation I want to avoid per-tenant clusters initially — expensive. Propose logical isolation (namespace + IAM boundaries) plus opt-in dedicated pools for top-tier customers.
Nina (Security): Compliance ask: HealthCo needs FIPS KMS and audit trail per-tenant. That becomes enterprise-only feature, not MVP.
Clara (CS): FinCorp will only sign with egress IP and SLA guarantees. They can be the pilot customer for dedicated pools.
Ashley (PM): Proposed launch criteria:
- Functional: region pinning, routing policies (latency/cost/affinity), per-tenant routing metadata
- Reliability: cross-region failover <5s detection, canary rollout for routing policy
- Security: per-tenant audit logs and encrypted at rest
- Ops: runbook + migration plan + dashboard metrics
Devin (Eng-Arch): Tech spec snippet for policy DSL (rough):
```
policy {
  prefer: "region:us-east-1"
  fallback: ["region:us-west-2","region:eu-west-1"]
  isolation: "logical"
  tenant: "tenant_id"
}
```
Sam (Infra): Perf question — caching: KV-cache must be tenant-scoped to avoid leakage. That increases memory overhead; need cost model.
Leo (Product Ops): Prioritization: score each feature by revenue impact, engineering effort, and risk. My rough rank: (1) region pinning, (2) egress IPs, (3) per-tenant caching isolation, (4) dedicated pools, (5) FIPS/KMS.
Ashley (PM): Scope negotiation: MVP = items 1,3 (logical isolation), minimal telemetry. Stretch = 2,4,5 — gated by pilot revenue.
Devin (Eng-Arch): Rollout plan: feature-flagged routing policies -> pilot with FinCorp -> bake for 4 wks -> general availability. Add a circuit-breaker policy to auto-fallback on high error rate.
Nina (Security): Need acceptance tests for compliance features (audit log completeness, KMS config). Include in launch criteria that enterprise customers must pass compliance checklist.
Clara (CS): I'll line up FinCorp pilot and draft contract language for dedicated pool opt-in. Need exact SLO wording from eng.
Sam (Infra): Can we commit to a canary of 5% traffic per region first? That gives us safety.
Ashley (PM): Yes. Action items:
- Devin: deliver architecture PR + perf cost estimate by Fri
- Sam: cost model for tenant-scoped cache & egress IPs by Mon
- Nina: compliance acceptance checklist draft by Wed
- Clara: pilot contract draft and customer expectations by Tue
- Leo: prioritization spreadsheet (scorecard) by end of week
Morgan Lee: Thanks. If we can get the PR + cost numbers we can present to EMs next Tues. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New release created: routing-policy-playbook v0.1 — build 482
Devin (Eng-Arch): One more note — timeline risk if quantization/kv-changes require runtime mods. Mark as dependency on eng-runtime team.
Ashley (PM): Noted. Tagging @eng-runtime to review dependency.
